documents.author: archive_org
documents.description: Here's an episode of one of those sleepy Saturday afternoon fishing shows that made you want to take a nap, "The Fishin' Hole" with Jerry McKinnis as aired on Atlanta, GA "superstation" WTCG Channel 17 (then a year's off from changing call letters to WTBS). Also featured are Jerry's children Mark and Mike, plus Harry Lambrith (sp?). (immediately preceding "The Fishin Hole" was the Movie 17 Saturday Matinee broadcast of "Sherlock Holmes Faces Death" which can be seen in its entirety here: https://youtu.be/5OOaRq9EAiQ) Includes: Station ID / help wanted for Pre-Prison Release Program Opening title sequence for The Fishin Hole, with sponsor billboard for Eagle Claw Fishing Tackle, Mercury Outboards, Ranger of Arkansas, Stihl chain saws, and Holiday Inn Commercials for: Eagle Claw fishing hooks Holiday Inn hotels Segment 1 of episode dealing with small-mouthed bass fishing, in which he and his assistants were fishing for same at the Quetico National Forest in nortwestern Ontario; here we see them in the water, going to the ranger station for their fishing permits, then going out in the water again to check the caught fishes' mouths Commercial: Mercury Fish Power boats - with actor/musician Jerry Reed Segment 2: Jerry and Harry Lambrith (sp?) at one side of the bay fishing, and speaking of how fish in the area were eagerly cooperating with their various baits Commercials for: Stihl chain saw Eagle Claw skirted-spool spinning wheel (with "Star Wars"-style motifs) Segment 3: Jerry gives advice on the overall fishing area and what to do (namely, "drop me a card"), then explaining how he and his sons, and Harry and wife Mary, did while they were out fishing Commercials for: Ranger Boats (spotlighting Flippin, AR and one of its native sons - and company founder - Forrest L. Wood) Mercury Quicksilver Accessories (with actor/musician Jerry Reed) Ending sponsor billboard (in same order as opening sponsor billboard) Ending credits: JM Associates (C) Executive Producer - Jim Manion Director - Pat Smith Videotape Editor - Jim Rogansky Audio Mixer - Bill Forsythe (seems like they fade out early and incomplete even after coming back for a moment) Commercial: Jenson Fishing Tackle Offer for free tickets to April 5th Braves / Georgia Tech game - compliments of Metro Atlanta Union 76 PSA for United States Savings Bonds Station ID / promo/film clip for "Everything's Ducky" for Sunday at 4:30pm (EST) (immediately following the Fishin Hole was "Bill Dance Outdoors" - the first 10 minutes of the broadcast can be seen here: https://youtu.be/Z4JF8BoV0MA) This aired on local Atlanta TV (and nationally via cable) on Saturday, April 1st 1978 during the 5:00pm to 5:30pm (Eastern) timeframe. About The Museum of Classic Chicago Television: The MCCTv (FuzzyMemoriesTV) is a 501(c)(3) non-profit whose primary mission is the preservation and display of off-air, early home videotape recordings (70s to early 80s, mostly) recorded off of TV (in Chicago or other cities now too); things which would likely be lost if not sought out and preserved digitally. If you have any old 1970s videotapes recorded off of TV please email: tapes@fuzzy.tv Even though (mostly) short clips are displayed here, we preserve the entire broadcasts in our archives - the complete programs with breaks (or however much is present on the tape), for historical preservation. For information on how to help in our mission, to donate or lend tapes to be converted to DVD, please e-mail tapes@fuzzy.tv Thank you for your help!

documents.document_title: Anomalous behavior of control pulses in presence of noise with singular autocorrelation
documents.normalized_title: anomalous behavior of control pulses in presence of noise with singular autocorrelation
documents.author: archive_org
documents.description: We report on the anomalous behavior of control pulses for spins under spin-spin relaxation and subject to classical noise with a singular autocorrelation function. This behavior is not detected for noise with analytic autocorrelation functions. The effect is manifest in the different scaling behavior of the deviation of a real pulse to the ideal, instantaneous one. While a standard pulse displays scaling $\propto \tau_\mathrm{p}^1$, a first-order refocusing pulse normally shows scaling $\propto \tau_\mathrm{p}^2$. But in presence of cusps in the noise autocorrelation the scaling $\propto \tau_\mathrm{p}^{3/2}$ occurs. Cusps in the autocorrelation are characteristic for fast fluctuations in the noise with a spectral density of Lorentzian shape. We prove that the anomalous exponent cannot be avoided; it represents a fundamental limit. On the one hand, this redefines the strategies one has to adopt to design refocusing pulses. On the other hand, the anomalous exponent, if found in experiment, provides important information on the noise properties.

documents.description: This leaf blower attachment is designed for standard Stihl line trimmers (mine is an FS 56). It doesn't have a ton of power, but it is good for light duty blowing tasks. I don't really know anything about designing blowers - this was very roughly modeled after an old Toro electric leaf blower, but it doesn't blow nearly as hard (the electric motor runs much faster than a trimmer engine). I've included CAD files for anyone who wants to make improvements. CAUTION: Do not run the impeller without the housing fully attached - if your impeller print fails it will *explode* everywhere! Watch it go: https://youtu.be/tFOtBASdfvo

documents.description: +++ Deindustrialisierung durch Ihre Energiewende und das Verbrenner-Aus durch die EU-Bevormundung – Der ehemalige Industriestandort Baden-Württemberg ist 2024 EU-weit Drittletzter beim BIP-Wachstum! +++ „Wir brauchen keinen dirigistischen Staat, sondern im Gegenteil mehr Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und mehr Flexibilität“. Das sagte der mittelstandspolitische Sprecher Bernd Gögel MdL in der Landtagsdebatte zum Industriestandort Baden-Württemberg. „Für 2024 werden 0,1 Prozent BIP-Wachstum in Deutschland prognostiziert. Das ist der drittletzte Platz in der gesamten EU. Und Wirtschaftspolitik wird abgesehen von Brüssel nun einmal primär in Berlin gestaltet, wo Sie den Kanzler stellen, liebe SPD! Aktuell zeigt uns übrigens gerade dieser SPD-Bundeskanzler, dass er wesentliche Grundlagen unserer Wirtschaftsordnung nicht verstanden hat oder sogar vorsätzlich ignoriert: Mit der Forderung, den gesetzlichen Mindestlohn auf 15 Euro anzuheben, missachtet Olaf Scholz nicht nur die eigentlich zuständige Kommission, sondern zugleich auch das Prinzip der Tarifautonomie. Außerdem demonstriert der Kanzler damit, wo er sich und seine Politik selbst sieht: Als Befürworter eines Staates, der die Wirtschaft bevormundet. Genau das brauchen wir aber nicht.“ Bosch, ZF, Stihl - die Anzeichen sind dafür vorhanden, dass das Jahr 2024 zum „Jahr der Deindustrialisierung“ zu werden droht, moniert Gögel. „Mit dem auf EU-Ebene beschlossenen Verbrenner-Aus ab dem Jahr 2035 ist die gesamte Autoindustrie in Europa erpressbar geworden. Und kurzzeitige Stromausfälle haben bereits im vergangenen Jahr bei Unternehmen gehäuft zu Produktionsausfällen und Maschinenschäden geführt. Als AfD-Fraktion fordern wir deshalb auch heute die Rückkehr zu einer sozialen Marktwirtschaft, die unseren Unternehmen verlässliche Rahmenbedingungen gewährleistet. Und unsere Wirtschaft benötigt in großem Umfang Fachkräfte, die über eine angemessene Bildung verfügen. Die von Ihnen demgegenüber geförderte Masseneinwanderung in die Sozialsysteme verhindert genau hier eine richtige Schwerpunktsetzung. Nicht zuletzt steht die AfD auch für eine langfristig zuverlässige und bezahlbare Stromversorgung. Das muss mit einem Wiedereinstieg in die Kernkraft einhergehen. Es sind grundsätzliche Fehlentwicklungen zu korrigieren – noch ist es dafür aber nicht zu spät.“

documents.description: NOS Achtuurjournaal (eight o'clock news). Broadcast from 2021-04-04. NOS Journaal is the umbrella name for the news broadcasts of the Dutch public broadcaster NOS on radio and television. The 8pm broadcast is the oldest and considered to be the most important edition of NOS Journaal, typically lasting for 25 minutes. Transcription: Na zeven lange, mooie en ook loodzware weken is het eindelijk zover: Vanavond wordt bekend wie die o zo gewilde hoofdrol gaat pakken. Wordt het Nandi, Natascha of Tessa? U thuis bepaalt! De zinderende finale van Op Zoek Naar Maria. Dat wilt u niet missen! Kijken dus, straks na het Journaal. Tot zo! NPO ONDERTITELING TT888, 2021 informatie: service.npo.nl 888 Nederland stuurt zorgpersoneel naar Curacao om te helpen. Ja, de nood is hoog. Er is daar nu echt een kritieke situatie. Dus ze kunnen alle hulp gebruiken. En verder in het nieuws vandaag. Vluchtelingen in Mozambique zitten tussen twee vuren. Nederland viert het paasfeest. LIVEPROGRAMMA, ONDERTITELING KAN ACHTERLOPEN Curacao wordt hard getroffen door het coronavirus. Het eiland heeft relatief het hoogst aantal nieuwe gevallen ter wereld. Vooral onder jonge mensen. De zorg kan het nauwelijks aan. Er is groot te kort aan ziekenhuispersoneel en beademingsapparaten. Nederland stuurt daarom verpleegkundigen en artsen naar het eiland. Twintig mensen vertrekken dit paasweekend. Arts Stijn Kluft en verpleegkundige Ansie Korenstra kennen elkaar niet maar vertrekken samen voor twee maanden naar Curaçao om daar hulp te bieden. Ik ga naar Curaçao om te ondersteunen daar in het ziekenhuis als verpleegkundige. Vanwege de enorme coronacrisis. Ik ga ondersteunen waar ik kan. De zorgbehoefte is daar enorm toegenomen, te weinig personeel. Dus ze kunnen alle hulp gebruiken. Ik voel me geroepen om daar te helpen. Vlak voor vertrek is er onzekerheid of verpleegkundige Korenstra mee kan. Van haar negatieve PCR-test bij de GGD heeft ze geen bewijs. Ze laat zich daarom opnieuw testen in de hoop toch mee te kunnen. En haar hulp op het eiland is hard nodig. Nergens ter wereld is het aantal geregistreerde besmettingen zo hoog als op Curaçao. 177 besmettingen per 100.000 inwoners. we hebben 44 patiënten op de intensive care liggen. We hadden een IC waar 16 personen op konden. Hoe goed we ook ons best doen op een gegeven moment heb je niet genoeg personeel om de aanstroom aan te kunnen. We zijn blij met onze zuster eilanden die helpen. En de hulp die we van Nederland gaan ontvangen. De uitslag van de sneltest van Ansie Korenstra wordt niet geaccepteerd, ze kan vandaag niet mee. Stijn Kluft vertrekt vliegt vandaag dus alleen en Ansie Korenstra vertrekt morgen met de eerste volgende vlucht. De komende dagen stuurt Nederland nog eens 9 artsen en verpleegkundigen. Wie vanuit Nederland naar Duitsland gaat, moet een negatieve coronatest kunnen laten zien. De maatregel gaat dinsdag in. Dat heeft de Duitse regering besloten. compleet Er komen geen grenscontroles, wel steekproeven. Wie langs de kant wordt gezet door de politie, moet direct een negatieve test laten zien. Tot nu toe kregen reizigers in Duitsland daar nog 48 uur de tijd voor. Nu niet meer, en ook moet de reis online worden aangemeld. Voor woon-werk-verkeer en vrachtverkeer komt een uitzondering. De branche-organisatie verwacht daarom weinig problemen. Nederland is het vierde buurland van Duitsland dat als hoog-risico-land wordt aangemerkt. Eerder werd aan Tsjechië, Polen en Frankrijk dezelfde maatregel opgelegd. Het Nederlandse ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken adviseert mensen sowieso om tot en met 15 mei niet naar het buitenland te reizen. De regering en het leger van Jordanië zeggen dat er een complot is verijdeld om het land te destabiliseren. Een aantal hoge functionarissen is gearresteerd. En de halfbroer van de koning, prins Hamzah zegt dat hij onder huisarrest is geplaatst. In een videoboodschap ontkent prins Hamzah elke betrokkenheid bij de politieke onrust. Maar hij heeft wel stevige kritiek op de machthebbers in Jordanië. Prins Hamzah is de halfbroer van koning Abdullah, tot 2004 was hij de kroonprins. Het leger van Jordanië ontkent dat de prins onder huisarrest staat'. Hem zou alleen zijn gevraagd te stoppen met zijn kritiek. Volgens vice-premier Safadi had prins Hamzah contact met buitenlandse partijen. Het Jordaanse koningshuis heeft veel macht, meer dan het parlement. Veel Arabische landen en de Verenigde Staten hebben vandaag hun steun uitgesproken aan koning Abdullah. Allemaal benadrukken ze dat Jordanië een belangrijke rol heeft voor de stabiliteit in het Midden-Oosten. Dan naar Mozambique, Oost-Afrika. Meer dan een half miljoen mensen zitten klem tussen de terreur van jihadisten en het geweld van het regeringsleger. Volgens Amnesty International worden mensenrechten op grote schaal geschonden door regeringssoldaten en huurlingen uit Zuid-Afrika. Veel burgers in het noorden zijn van het vasteland gevlucht naar eilandjes, zoals Qui-rimba. Maar ook daar zijn ze niet veilig. De kusttrook in het noorden van Mozambique is nu vrijwel onbewoond. Veel van de half miljoen gevluchte kustbewoners kwamen hier terecht. Aan hun lot overgelaten op afgelegen eilandjes. Ze komen allemaal van het continent daar. Het vasteland. Ze zijn hier naartoe gevlucht. Iedereen op dit eiland kan gruwelijke verhalen vertellen over de dag waarop de jihadisten naar hun dorp kwamen. Ook op de eilanden hebben de jihadisten een spoor van vernieling achtergelaten. Een belangrijke aanwijzing waarom ze dit huis hebben gekozen Frelimo. Hij werkt voor de regeringspartij van Mozambique. Frelimo. Dat betekent dat het jihadisten op zoek waren naar hem. En een rekening te vereffenen hebben met de regeringspartij. Maar de burgers moeten niet alleen de jihadisten vrezen maar ook de helikopters van Zuid-Afrikaanse huurlingen... die in opdracht van hun eigen regering lukraak op dorpen schieten. Zo wordt in het noorden van Mozambique de burgerbevolking vertrapt tussen jihadisten, het regeringsleger en hun huurlingen. Gestrand op verlaten eilanden in een oorlog zonder einde in zicht. De VPRO zendt vanavond de documentaire uit die Bram Vermeulen maakte in het noorden van Mozambique. Om vijf-voor half tien. Op NPO2. Lilian Marijnissen van de SP wil dat andere partijen duidelijk maken of ze wel of niet in een kabinet willen met VVD leider Mark Rutte. Dat zei ze in WNL op Zondag. Ik zou juist andere partijen op willen roepen om dat te doen. Andere partijen? Ja, andere partijen. Dan denk ik aan de PvdA en GroenLinks in de eerste plaats. Maar ook zeker CDA en D66. documents.description: This tape is a complete off-air recording of WTRF-TV News Channel 7's evening news block from Wheeling, West Virginia, capturing both the First News at 5:30 and the News at 6, along with all commercial breaks and the Sports from TJ's segment that followed. The date is April 19, 1995, the day after the Oklahoma City bombing of the Alfred P. Murrah Federal Building.   The bombing dominates both newscasts. Anchors Frank O'Brien and Brenda Deinhart report that 36 people are confirmed dead including 12 children, with the toll expected to rise. Attorney General Janet Reno announces a $2 million reward. The FBI identifies the bomb as fertilizer and fuel oil carried in a rented truck, issues arrest warrants for two white male suspects, and Agent Weldon Kennedy confirms the vehicle used. President Clinton calls it an attack on the United States. Reporter Leslie Gatis interviews a Wheeling resident who witnessed the 1983 U.S. Embassy bombing in Beirut. A local political science professor discusses the rise of domestic terrorism in the wake of the 1993 World Trade Center bombing. Meteorologist John Dominic delivers the exclusive AccuWeather forecast, with the current temperature at 53 degrees, a high of 74 expected the following day, and scattered showers through the weekend. Sports anchor Gino Startori broadcasts from TJ's sports bar, where Wheeling Thunderbirds coach Doug Sutter discusses the team's first-round East Coast Hockey League playoff elimination by the Birmingham Bulls, league meetings scheduled for May 8, and whether he will return next season. Other local stories include the third and final day of the official search for Monroe County resident Howard Staller in the Ohio River near Sardis; the cancellation of Weirton's annual international food and arts festival due to construction, with a replacement mini-festival planned for July 4 at Starvage Pool; a delayed Blockbuster Video opening in the Woodsville area strip mall, now expected in July; Project BESS announcing $20,000 in scholarships to ten area colleges; West Liberty State College's 12th annual multicultural festival; and a fire prevention segment on spring barbecue and lawnmower safety. Hard Copy promoted a Friday-at-5 exclusive on Selena's death and Oklahoma City coverage on WTRF. WTRF listed its internet presence as Prodigy under CBS WTRFTV and wtrf98a@prodigy.com. News tips could be submitted via Star TV 7 on the Wireless One network.   Local advertisers include Gallagher and Sons Monuments, Wheeling National Bank Equity Bank Line, Stapolino Chevrolet Geo on Route 7 in Martin's Ferry, Heilig-Meyers furniture No Cash Attack Thursday through Saturday, Quality Farm and Fleet, 84 Lumber with Winco Summit sliding patio doors, Ponderosa Delmonico steak dinner, Orkin exterminator, Train HVAC Excel Series heat pump at 232-6846, and Dixon ZTR riding mowers. Regional auto dealers include Whiteside Pontiac, Montgomery Pontiac, JNJ Pontiac, Lovedee Motor Sales, and Wealthy Pontiac promoting the 1995 Pontiac Bonneville at 3.6% APR; the Grand Olds Gang retailers with the 1995 Oldsmobile Achieva at $13,995; the Buick Connection with the 1995 Regal under $21,000; Dodge promoting the Stratus and Caravan with $1,000 cash back; Ford Taurus with $1,000 cash back; Mercury Mystique at $15,850; and Subaru Legacy wagon at 1.9% financing. National advertisers include Stihl chainsaws, Craft Deluxe macaroni and cheese, and the News Channel 7 AccuWeather 24-hour instant weather hotline sponsored by Bor Incorporated.

documents.description: We consider pulses of finite duration for coherent control in the presence of classical noise. We derive the corrections to ideal, instantaneous pulses for the case of general decoherence (spin-spin relaxation and spin-lattice relaxation) up to and including the third order in the duration \tau_p of the pulses. For pure dephasing (spin-spin relaxation only), we design \pi and \pi/2 pulses with amplitude and/or frequency modulation which resemble the ideal ones up to and including the second order in \tau_p. For completely general decoherence including spin-lattice relaxation the corrections are computed up to and including the second order in \tau_p as well. Frequency modulated pulses are determined which resemble the ideal ones. They are used to design a low-amplitude replacement for XY8 cycles. In comparison with pulses designed to compensate quantum noise less conditions have to be fulfilled. Consequently, we find that the classical pulses can be weaker and simpler than the corresponding pulses in the quantum case.

Depending on your gears you will also need to modify your driveshaft... epoxy does the job :-) My esc is also very big and fits only next to the motor and my lipo is sitting on top of the brace. I have had to extend the body by 1.5 cm and it´s only mounted with velcro. No issues so far and it´s nice to have gearing options! By the way, i´m using gear lubricant for brushcutters / clearing saws (STIHL) in my differentials. Still running the original ones. Happy bashing :-)

168 p. : 27 cm
Mit dem Aufruf "Die Phantasie an die Macht" unterstützte der Künstler Pierre Soulages den Aufstand der Pariser Studenten im Mai 1968. Die Bandbreite zwischen Utopie und erlebter Geschichte verleiht den politischen Plakaten der Künstler der Avantgarde ihren besonderen Reiz. Diese Geschichte der internationalen Protestbewegungen, erzählt mit eindringlichen Entwürfen der grossen Künstler unserer Zeit, ist zugleich eine Geschichte der Kunst dieser Zeit - selektiv betrachtet, aber doch Ausdruck einer erstaunlichen Kontinuität und Authentizität. documents.description: Designed an attachment for my Stihl leaf blower for a rectangle head to get into tight corners better. Its designed for the Stihl BG56 blower with a firm friction fit but the inside diameter on my attachment is 70mm wide so it will fit any other blower with that diameter pipe. I've added 2 ridges at the base of the attachment so you can put a cut in it and have a zip tie holding it on if your blower has a bigger or smaller pipe. (not needed for the BG56) I printed mine in esun pla+ at a 0.2 layer height with the rectangle side on the build plate with a 10 line brim for better adhesion.

documents.document_title: Stihl Combi Plastic Sleve (Manguito interior Combi) (5836017)
documents.normalized_title: stihl combi plastic sleve manguito interior combi 5836017
documents.author: archive_org
documents.description: This is a replacement for tthe Stihl's Combi plastic sleve that commonly brokes. It's better to buy an original one, because is stronger than the tipical 3D printing materials (Unless you print it with PC or Nylon, etc..). But sometimes there's not a store nearby or they are closed, for this emergency cases I've made this model. Printing setting and tips: I tried to printing it in vertical position, but due to alignment of the printing lines with the maximum torque that the piece suffers it's so easy to get the piece broken (Speccially at the hinge). So, I tried to print it horizontally tilted 15º (Like in the photo) so the lines are not aligned with the torque that the combi made. I used: PLA (You can test stronger or better materials) Layer Height: 0.2mm Supports (You can experiment also). Default values unless: Normal Everywhere Overhang 60º Bed adeshion: Brim. Everything else: Default PLA from Cura ESPAÑOL Esto es un reemplazo para el manguito de plástico de la Combi de Stihl que típicamente se rompe. Lo mejor es comprar uno original, porque es más fuerte que los materiales típicos de impresión 3D (A menos que lo imprimas con PC o Nylon, etc.). Pero a veces no tienes una tienda cerca o está cerrado, para estos casos de emergencia he hecho este modelo. Configuración de impresión y consejos: Intenté imprimirlo en posición vertical, pero al estar alineadas las líneas de impresión con la fuerza máxima que sufre la pieza es muy fácil que se rompa (Especialmente en la bisagra). Así que probé a imprimirla en horizontal inclinada 15º (Como en la foto) para que las líneas no queden alineadas con el par que hace la combi. He utilizado: PLA (Se puede probar con materiales más fuertes o mejores). Altura de capa: 0.2mm Soportes (Puedes experimentar también). Valores por defecto a menos que: Normal En todas partes Voladizo 60º Adhesión a la placa: Borde. Todo lo demás: Ajustes predeterminados de Cura

documents.description: These Stihl earmuff bases are known for breaking (granted, it took a pretty good tug on mine, completely my fault). I did a few iterations of this as ABS is the strongest material I keep on hand and I needed to beef up the weak points (doesn't affect usability, just weight I suppose). documents.document_title: The Effect of Operation and Engine Speed on Chainsaw Vibration
documents.normalized_title: the effect of operation and engine speed on chainsaw vibration
documents.author: archive_org
documents.description: Introduction Tree felling is an important part of forest exploitation. According to the condition of Iranian forests, mechanization in these forests has not been grown as it should be. Therefore, a main part of tree felling operations are performed by chainsaw. This machine can cause high level hand-arm vibration which is one of the main reasons of white finger syndrome. This syndrome affects the nerves, blood vessels, muscles, and joints of the hand, wrist, and arm. Reducing and controlling chainsaw vibrations are unlikely to be achievable without awareness of effective factors of it. So, the effects of various factors should be studied. It seems that, single cylinder engine and the interaction of the chain with wood can be the main reasons of chainsaw vibration. Therefore, in the current study the effects of engine rotary speed and wood type on the vibration acceleration of a common chainsaw have been investigated. In contrast to the previous studies, no-cutting condition as a control sample was added to experiments and the effects of cutting itself were evaluated. Experiments were also conducted in three different engine speeds to investigate the effects of interaction between wood species and engine speed. Materials and Methods The vibration acceleration was measured on three orthogonal axes on the front handle of Stihl-070 chainsaw. The measurements were conducted at three levels of engine speed (6000, 7720, and 8630 RPM) during four operations. The operations include cutting three types of Iranian woods (Beech, Hornbeam, and Alder) and no-cutting as a control sample. The experiments were conducted in split-factorial design where the operation was taken as main plot and different speeds and directions as factors. A single-axis piezoelectric accelerometer (VMI-192) was used to sense the vibration. Vibration signals were received and analyzed by a portable data acquisition system (Easy Viber). The RMS vibration acceleration at one-third octave frequency bands in the center frequency range between 6.3Hz to 1250Hz were calculated from acceleration-frequency vibration spectra. Then, the amounts of frequency-weighted vibration acceleration (ahw) were computed based on international standards. SAS software was used to analyze the data statistically. Results and Discussion The results of ANOVA showed that the effect of operation on frequency-weighted acceleration was insignificant, but the effects of engine speed and vibration axis were significant at the 1% level. When the chainsaw was free of cutting, the vibration acceleration values were lower in lower frequencies and higher in higher frequencies compared to cutting wood operations. There was a significant difference between the vibration acceleration in 6000 RPM engine speed and other two speeds, but the differences between 7720 RPM and 8630 RPM engine speeds was insignificant. However, an increase in engine rotary speed increased the value of frequency-weighted vibration acceleration. The acceleration-frequency vibration spectra had peaks at frequencies in accordance with the engine combustion frequencies (100 Hz in 6000, 125 Hz in 7720, and 160 Hz in 8630). Maximum value of unweighted vibration acceleration was observed during no-cutting operations in 6000, 7720, and 8630 RPM engine speeds to be 77.2, 138.6, and 139.0 m s -2 , respectively. Vibration acceleration was highest along the Xh (perpendicular to the palm area) equal to 12.05 m.s -2 followed by Yh axis (along the third metacarpal bone) with the value of 9.12 m s -2 . Altogether, the results of these tests indicated that the vibration level of employed chainsaw in this study is very higher than other machines has been investigated by other researchers. Conclusion The effects of wood species and engine speed on the hand-transmitted vibration of chainsaw were evaluated. The operation has not significantly affected the frequency-weighted vibration acceleration. However, cutting operations, increase and decrease the vibration acceleration values in lower and higher frequencies, respectively. The frequency-weighted vibration acceleration had higher values in higher engine speeds. Also, it is concluded that the risk of white finger syndrome among the operators of this type of chainsaw is very high.

documents.description: I got aggravated at fighting and loosing multiple circlips when installing them on my Stihl MS360 chainsaw. The Stihl OEM tool is about 80 bucks which I'm sure works amazingly, but it's expensive for use very rarely. No other manufacturer is making an installation tool for these small pistons. Using this tool I was able to install said circlips on the piston face while said face was pointing away from me without any issues. The file included is for 10mm circlips, it is easily adaptable for different sizes. I downsized the the tube by .2mm and then the rod another .2mm for a hassle free fit.

documents.description: The Stihl Filling System is great. Screw it to the petrol can and fill your chainsaw without spilling a drop. But the system will only fit to Stihl cans with quite expensive fuel. I found another fuel and first used a funnel to fill it into the stihl can. Now I made the adapter, which works fine. **Please note that fuel can be dangerous - especially fuel gases leaking from the can!** **UPDATE** I added a version2 with more "grip" - and - as I tried printing TPU - I added a gasket as well. It´s much easier to get it tight with the seal. You can proof it by gently pressing the can: You will hear the air passing off, if it's not tight enough. This is importend: When it´s not airtight, the system will not work well. I made mine from PLA and I am not sure how long it will last. So another warning: Use it as careful as I do. Don't leave it on for a longer time and check it's tightness and stability everytime you use it. **OLD VERSION** There is a gasket in the filling system that works, but non on the side of the adapter to the can. Nevertheless mine was airtight. I just hat to screw it very tight to the red can. You can proof it by gently pressing the can: You will hear the air passing off, if it's not tight enough. There is a version with modified diameter for an oil cannister as well: https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:3411577/

documents.description: Chainsaw hanger. I have tested it with a MS 361 and a MS 241. Used to hang chainsaws vertically on garage wall. The mount is comprised of a separate base and hanger. Print the base flat with the rib up and the hanger as it would be on the wall. You want the layer lines to stack from the bottom to the top to prevent layer breakage while in use. I glue the base to the hanger with PVC cement but its not necessary. Choose the appropriate material for your storage environment. I used PLA + but where I store at doesn't get hot.

documents.description: The Stihl Filling System is great. Screw it to the oil cannisster and fill your chainsaw without spilling a drop. But the system will only fit to Stihl cans with quite expensive oil. I found another oil and first used a funnel to fill it into the stihl can. Now I made the adapter, which works fine. **Please note that can be a harm to nature - even the organic oil - so don´t spill it!** I added a gasket as well. It´s much easier to get it tight with the seal. Print it from TPU. You can proof it by gently pressing the can: You will hear the air passing off, if it's not tight enough. This is importend: When it´s not airtight, the system will not work well. I made my adapter from PLA and I am not sure how long it will last. So another warning: Use it as careful as I do. Don't leave it on for a longer time and check it's tightness and stability everytime you use it. Here is my adapter for fuel-cans: https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:3020773/

documents.description: I installed a Stihl 041 Carburetor instead of the stock NT carb that comes with most of the bicycle motor kits because mine was super painful to tune. I customized this intake as one alternative since I couldn't find anything easily available. The chainsaw carbs have twin needles and let you tune the idle and WOT throttle on the fly - no more jet swapping! NOTE: YMMV! I have no idea how it will last but I did coat mine in epoxy to extend the life. FWIW, the intake is actually cold after running a bit from the effects of the humidity in the air, so I think it won't melt. :)

documents.description: Broadcast from 2021-03-28 of Dutch late evening talk show 'OP1'. Op1 is a Dutch talk show on television that is broadcasted on the late evening on NPO 1. The presentation is in the hands of changing duos, each of which can be seen on a specific fixed day for a specific broadcaster. As a producer, TVBV is responsible for the core editing of the program and thus monitors the format. Discussions about current topics and a reflection on the issues of the day, with various guests and opinion makers, are central. Transcription: *'t voelt niet falen toch, zonder schroom *Zij zal blijven stralen *Ooit vind ik mijn droom* APPLAUS DIT PROGRAMMA WERD LIVE ONDERTITELD NPO ONDERTITELING TT888, 2021 informatie: service.npo.nl Woede en ongeloof vandaag bij het zien van deze beelden. Kunt u zeggen waarom u... Argh! Verslaggever Jacco van Giessen werd vanochtend mishandeld door een kerkganger. En een auto reed in op een collega. Volgens Andries Knevel hadden de kerken nooit open gemogen voor bezoekers. SP-leider Lilian Marijnissen wil de onderste steen boven in de ontspoorde verkenning. Kan ze nog wel vol vertrouwen terug naar de onderhandelingstafel? Intensivist Diederik Gommers en viroloog Marion Koopmans zijn niet van de televisie te slaan. documents.description: This thing is a foldable clothes line toy for 18" dolls. Actually, it is probably sturdy enough to work as a real collapsible clothesline if one would simply use longer sticks. You need to make some of the thing parts out of wood. Here's a list of what you need: Base. For the base, I didn't bother drawing anything up. I simply cut an 8" square out of 3/4" plywood and drilled a 1/2" hole in the center. I would probably not print this because it needs to be quite heavy to prevent the whole thing from tipping over. Post: this is an 18" piece of 1/2" wooden dowel. Ribs and Stretchers: These are made of 3/8" wooden dowel. The dimensions for these are noted in the PDF, which you can find with the rest of the thing files. Pins: I used a heavy trimer line for the pins. A piece of thin wooden dowel would probably work as well. The holes are printed 1/8 but I drilled mine out to accommodate the heavy trimmer line. The line I used was a Stihl 0.13" nylon. Line. I used a piece of cord that I had left over from a window blind kit. Nearly anything would work, provided it is strong enough. Most yarn is probably too weak. I installed the line in one piece, threading it through the inner holes first, then running it through the outer holes. This eliminates the step of having to adjust the length of each line (since there is only one line). I superglued the ends of the line to keep them from fraying. Assembly: Please view the video before gluing the ribs to the hinges. Also see the video for how to assemble the whole thing. It is probably wise to pin everything up before you glue anything. Obviously, you can change the length of the ribs and the pole, as mentioned earlier. I used super glue to permanently set all the pins and the hinges.

documents.description: Inspired by Fazerboy's model, I thought this looked like a great spool holder for my Rostock Max V2. It is not as sophisticated as RMLynch's design (http://www.thingiverse.com/thing:1060029) But easier to get spools on so I thought it would be a nice compromise. The hardware i used consisted of stuff I had lying around. For the bearings I used a Gear head bearing 9.5x22.2x7.14mm. (Available on eBay: http://www.ebay.com/itm/NEW-STIHL-Trimmer-Gearhead-Ball-Bearing-FS-44-74-80-85-/350330092447?hash=item51914cfb9f:m:m3NkvbAKn0UHqUhzku2ysrw) For the shaft I used a 3/8 inch rod. It has a nominal diameter of 9.47mm Make sure the bearings fit before committing. I found some inconsistency in different 3/8 inch rods. You can also use 3/8 pipe, etc. The rod will have a nominal length of 15cm. This depends a bit on the quality of the print and if you can get the rod to its full depth. Some trial and error may apply. To connect the end cap I used two #4x1/2 pan head sheet metal screws. These do not hold any weight so they do not have to be too tight. The spacers are 14.5mm long. These allow for the five bearings. If you want more bearings, you can do the math and adjust the spacer length. In real world use this spool holder works great. It probably reduces 80 to 90% of the tension off the filament.

documents.description: I made a Chain lube system for my bike. This works bij pressing a Primer bulb that is connected to a reservoir of gear oil. Bill of materials; -EP W90 Gear oil -https://www.ebay.com/itm/New-Motorcycle-Rear-Brake-Master-Cylinder-Tank-Oil-Cup-Fluid-Bottle-Reservoir-AP/172464956888?ssPageName=STRK%3AMEBIDX%3AIT&_trksid=p2057872.m2749.l2649 ( Brake reservoir) -Epoxy grade glue(Any 2 Component will work). -https://www.ebay.com/itm/Fish-Tank-Aquarium-Control-Valve-Airpump-Splitter-Air-Flow-Tube-4mm-Pipe-Nozzle/332264477662?ssPageName=STRK%3AMEBIDX%3AIT&var=541275182073&_trksid=p2057872.m2749.l2649 (There are cheaper ones) -https://www.ebay.com/itm/1-5-10pcs-Petrol-Snap-Fuel-Bulb-Pump-in-Primer-for-Stihl-Ryobi-WALBRO-HUSQVARNA/192063764781?epid=505373856&hash=item2cb7e4792d:m:mmINksUzYsv1C1hYNyRFpNw (Petrol Primer bulb) -Hose with Inner diameter of 4 mm. Installation PDF is included above, Please leave feedback on the retarded things i put into it :). NOTE; I printed these parts in PETG, and they still work after 500 miles. DON'T print the nozzle and main body for the pump with support in the inner channels. YOU WON'T GET THE SUPPORT OUT. It will print out fine without support on the inner channels. (The hose connection should have support obiously) Also the nozzle for the rear sprocket is made for a 520 CHAIN. it might or might not fit a different chain/sprocket. I did add another nozzle, might be usefull depending on the bike you are riding. Happy DIY :)

documents.description: I CLAIM NO LIABILITY FOR USE, MISUSE OR ANY OTHER DAMN THING FOR THIS NOVELTY "MOVIE PROP" If you make this thing you are taking liability upon yourself to use a power tool in a way the manufacturer did not intend, out of parts that you are responsible for verifying. Always wear the correct PPE -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Adapter to attach a standard 7-1/4" circular saw blade to a Stihl FS-40 trimmer. Just remove the trimmer line cartridge and it slips right on. Required parts: 7-1/4" "skillsaw" blade One Nut - 8mm x 1.25 8mm Washer 8mm Lock washer The printed parts hold the blade centered, the original steel shaft and nut hold the blade onto the trimmer. I used PETG for strength. The tightening of the bolt clamps the blade between the top and bottom 3D printed parts, it is kept from spinning through friction alone. If I was dumb enough to build and use it I would tell you that it mows through little saplings like nobody's business.

documents.description: I made this thing to replace the worn out velcro strap that came with my Stihl Magnum blower. I designed it for nylon; YMMV with other materials. It secures to the nozzle with a small ziptie, and hooks to the top corner of the blower (as shown in the photo), to keep the nozzle at bay during storage and transportation. The Stihl nozzle measures 42mm diameter where the strap goes. I added 3mm radius to give a looser fit for easier operation (and so it dangles out of the way while using the blower). The strap is 2mm thick, and the hook part is 4mm thick. So it won't burn a ton of filament, nor will it weigh you down. Appropriately, this was my first print using some 0.17mm nylon weed trimmer line I bought on clearance sale at the local hardware store. My enclosed A8+e3d did a great job at 0.2x0.45mm, 260/100C (45C ambient), and 40mm/s. The resulting strap (and the part on the blower where it hooks to) easily supported the weight of the motor when I held it by the nozzle and shook it around. It also doesn't unhook while carrying the blower by the handle (a pet peev with the stock velcro strap). Enjoy, and please share if you find it useful for your blower, or something else.

documents.description: EGO Catalog 2025  Contributed to the Internet Archive in Honor and Memory of W.S. Van Dyke & James Wong Howe. On another topic... Do you have an interest in cine' film preservation? The Daniel D. Teoli Jr. Small Gauge Film Archive has a collection of thousands of reels measuring in the millions of feet of film. It is mostly 16mm, with some 8mm. While I have silent scanning equipment, sound 16mm scanners are out of my reach due to cost.  If you have an interest in investing in vintage film preservation and would like to contribute part or all of a scanner to the Archive, please contact me. I'm not looking for nickel and dime contributions. I tried that with Kickstarter, but they refused to run it.  I run 'The Peoples' Archive' and all the material I offer is open content...aka free. All the work I do is generally self-funded. Consequently, when I speak of investing, your return on investment is love for the preservation of history, which is the same payment I get for my work. documents.author: archive_org
documents.description: A study was conducted to analyze the performance of 3 electrostatic (Electrolon BP-2.5TM Spectrum Electrostatic 4010, and Spectrum Electrostatic head on a Stihl 420) and 2 conventional (Buffalo Turbine CSM2 and Stihl 420) sprayers for barrier sprays to suppress an adult mosquito population in an enclosed area. Sprayer characteristics such as charge-mass ratio, air velocity, flow rate, and droplet spectra were measured while spraying water. Dispersion of the spray cloud from these sprayers was determined using coverage on water-sensitive cards at various heights (0.5 m, 1.0 m, 1.5 m, 2.0 m, 2.5 m, and 3.0 m) and depths (1 m, 3 m, and 5 m) into the under-forest vegetation while spraying bifenthrin (TalstarTM 7.9% AI; FMC Corporation, Philadelphia, PA) at the rate of 21.8 ml/300 m of treated row. The charge-mass ratio data show that Electrostatic head on a Stihl 420 did not impart enough charge to the droplets to be considered as an electrostatic sprayer. In general, the charged spray cloud moved down toward the ground. The Electrolon BP 2.5 had significantly lower spray coverage on cards, indicating lack of spray dispersion. This sprayer had the lowest air velocity and did not have the air capacity needed to deliver droplets close to the target for electrostatic force to affect deposition. The analysis shows that these 2 sprayers are not a suitable choice for barrier sprays on vegetation. The results indicate that the Buffalo Turbine is suitable for barriers wider than 3 m, and the Spectrum 4010 and Stihl 420 are suitable for 1-3 m wide barriers.

documents.document_title: DTIC ADA494993: Droplet-Size Characterization of Handheld Atomization Equipment Typically Used in Vector Control
documents.normalized_title: dtic ada494993 droplet size characterization of handheld atomization equipment typically used in vector control
verification_notes: Official document keywords found: stihl, technical information.
documents.author: archive_org
documents.description: The atomization characteristics of 4 handheld sprayers (Leco P-l, Colt ULV Aerosol Generator, ULVAFAN MK2, Turbair ElectraFan 12) and a Stihl SR400 backpack sprayer were evaluated with the use of water and oil-based solutions. The effects on droplet-size spectrum (i.e., droplet size) for 3 insecticides (Tempo SC Ultra(R), Anvil 10+10(R), and Aqua-Reslin(R)) were also evaluated. Generic solutions were used to simulate the physical properties of the active-ingredient solutions in some tests. Significant differences were observed in the droplet spectrum generated by the different sprayers. The volume median diameter of the equipment tested ranged from 14.9 to 90.5 gm for the water-based solutions and from 11.7 to 92.4 tm for the oil-based solutions. The Colt ULV sprayer was the only one tested that complied with label requirements for aerosols, yielding acceptable Dv0.5 values of 14.9-16.0 lam with water-based Aqua-Reslin and 14.1 [am with Anvil 10+10. The information presented will allow equipment operators to make an informed decision when selecting equipment and operational parameters.

documents.description: This is a peg/pin for the perimeterwire used for a robotic lawn mower. #Advantages of this design:# * The pin/peg has holes that let the grass grow through it to ensure that it stays in the ground and doesn't come up after time. * The pin/peg can be printed horizontally, which removes the need for adhesion or supports. * The pin/peg is more robust because of the long horizontal layers instead of many seperate ones stacked above each other. **When placing the pins/pegs in your slicer watch out that the pin is laying on the side without the notch!** I hope you like my design and don't forget to share your make!

documents.description: A 3 3/4 hour edit/condensing of the 5 hour original from September 20, 1982. Tastes vary, your mileage may as well - consider this a taster. Use as directed. A SONIC BEASTIARY production by DJ Rex Mundi. CONTENTS Intro (Heaven & Hell) / 1974! 1975! 1969! 1971! (Joy To The World!) / Big News Tonight - Weather (with Kerry!) / Telegraph Avenue Street Fair / Try To Remember The Peace You've Found / Peter Gabriel - San Jacinto (OTE Remix) / Scary Sounds (Nobody Likes Me) / Tron, Flynn & Rann Were Enveloped In Gleaming Gold Cycles / Intergalactic Civilizations On Earth / Satan & Centipede / Clorox Cowboy - Credits / Miss Piggy Stereorobics / Midget Clown Interview / Officer Krupkie! / Sinceredrops & Dr. Condom / We've Got What You're Looking For / We've Got What You're Looking For / Your Kind Of People / It Delivers / Fingers Do The Walking - Coming Through In Waves / Piranha! (Poker Hands) / Stihl Chainsaws / Sound Communication - Dick Vaughn Is Not Ready - Stihl Chainsaws - Dick Vaughn / Dick Vaughn:  Michael Martin Murphey - Carolina In The Pines & Paul McCartney - Take It Away & Man Of Stihl Commercial & Paul Davis - Cool Night & Carly Simon - The Right Thing To Do & Miss America Shoes (Commercial) & Contest & It's A Beautiful Day - White Bird & P.A.V.E. (People Against Video Emptiheadedness) & America - You Can Do Magic & Dave Loggins - Please Come To Boston & Contra Costa Canal Drowning Threat! & Oliver - Good Morning Starshine & Elton John - Blue Eyes & Earwitness News & Handy Andy Commercial & Earwitness News - Weather & Chicago - You Are On My Mind (OTE Remix) & Jim Stafford - My Girl Bill (OTE Remix) & Dick Vaughn Plunderphonic Collapse / Perfectly Clear / Wake Up - Go To Sleep / Peter Gabriel - Shock The Monkey (OTE REMIX) / "Stimulus Level Is Much Too High" / Enigma / Raised On The Radio (Dub) - Smash The Radio / Credits / Pete Shelley - Homosapien (OTE Plunderphonics Remix) / Police Squad & Morse & Motels / Giant Laser - Reporting Distorting Recording / Alert! Receptacle Programming / COBOL Dump programming / Song For Cheryl - I Wish That It Would Rain / UFOs (Spurt Toothpaste) & Free Cardboard Box for Croquet Mallet Question / 'I Heard The Weatherman' Loop, Please, John! / Rainbow Calls In / A Media Song, Mistake / One Idea Could Get Us Out Of Here / Getting A Pencil / The Weatherman Interviews Lou Reed (with Omer Edge Commentary) / The Living Word Of God (The YOU Positioning of KFRC) / Credits / Peter Gabriel - San Jacinto (OTE RE-REMIX) / Who's Up There? (Over The Rainbow) / The Court Of The Crimson King.... REVIEW Big bunch of mixing going on. (I guess fans of The Weatherman would probably enjoy, around 1:20 until 2:00 - not included here - where the Weatherman sets up in the studio and it eventually devolves into a jumble of samples, recordings and loops as he gets more and more confused). Dick Vaughn slings some homosexual slurs around (and an even more notorious racist slur is stated later, as the name of a punk song). They seem to have real problems getting the studio set-up. Dick Vaughn does his usual schtick for about an hour. Then it's all kinds of mixing, Don on different microphones, Peter Gabriel and Pete Shelley (in a discussion between "Mickeys" we are told the Refrigerator Lady is a computer programmer now and doesn't do the show anymore). Late in the episode, Don claims it's "The Show About Media", so I used that as a subtitle. And a promise to be back first Sunday in October with Dick Vaughn all night long! documents.description: Designed up this dealer button to use in home games or have just as something laying around for any poker fan. It was inspired by a dealer button in Pokerstars VR. Printing: Ring - Infil to add weight, supports needed for spade inset. Letter embossing doesn't need it. Spade - Infil to add weight, no supports Letters - Print flat, already scaled to fit nicely in the embossing Star - Infil to add weight. Full print with 4x4x4 walls/top/bottom and 38% infil came to about 48g in weight. Glue in lettering and spade. Star may need minor sanding but should push fit into the space tightly and not need anything else to secure it.

documents.author: archive_org
documents.description: Bombilyius Major - what a wonderful name - also known as Large Bee Fly is a bee mimic; he has a long probyscus and hums happily whilst drinking nektar. Today on our threshing floor (Aloni) on a pleasant (25C) sunny day with a slight breeze he was in chorus with a stridulating Acrida mediterranea (grasshopper) -please can someone confirm spcies and activity - and strimmer (Apostolis with his Stihl). It seems as if they all try to tune to each other and sing in harmony. This was recorded using a Phonak lapel mic with low pass filter, mounted on a selfie stick with a mini Rycote windgag to an Olympus LS 14. Edited simply in Audacity: selection of fragment, fade i/o

documents.description: Rape-RMXs of early Nineties four-track recordings by Riefenstahl and Call Ov Stihl +++ 9 Tracks, 76:48 min ++ in addition to the remastered audio material, an outstanding printable artwork is part of the release. for more information visit http://www.privatelektro.de/rev_b_schipper.html The first full length Release by REVEREND BENN SCHIPPER Titel: "Dance Music For Shitheads With The YY Chromosome" including Rape-RMXs of early 90ties four-track recordings by Riefenstahl & Call Ov Stihl. Schipper was also a member of the early Column One and Tollwut. The Sound referending on industrial music, with a extensive use of guitar samples, electronical re-worked. In fact its hard to describe what the sound-definition is.. Some Tracks I would say are doom infected - some are more dark ambient with a slow rolling bass. But mostly the sound are no Glitch or pure Electronica, it is something inbetween. Most impressive is also the printable 16 page colour Art-Work for your pleasure and full of strange pictures and symbolistic adventures, great graphic and a strange manifest by the artist. One can see it a "fetish" or "dark" artwork with a lot of irony inside. This is definitly not an album for listening by on the couch, you might get into an abandoned industrial Area for this with your mp3 player! 9 Tracks, 76:48 min ++ 16 page printable colour artwork!

documents.description: This is a strut I put together on tinkercad (public, link at the bottom) to fix my broken lawnmower's wheel. The original plastic wheel broke at the axle, so I put together something to be able to quickly use the device. A new wheel would cost around €15, and a couple of weeks of wait time. The machine is a Stihl RME235 / Viking ME235 electric corded lawnmower, and I didn't want to print out a whole wheel, since the original one had a nice rubber around the edge, as well as for visual balance reasons. The wheel had a metal 8mm axle and the replacement strut should be able to fit any similar wheel with a diameter of over 130mm. The original wheel was fixed to the printed strut using cable ties. documents.normalized_title: back pack blower tube nozzle fix 4515981
documents.author: archive_org
documents.description: This is a very simple part for the working end of a Stihl back pack blower tube. Over the years this tube has worn down on my blower, several times, due to it touching the ground while in use. I have fixed this previously by duct taping a portion of soup can or something similar on the end. They have all eventually worn down as well and the cans can be heavy. The primary cylinder slips over the end of the nozzle and the ring is a wear surface. The wear surface, or wear ring, can be replaced whenever necessary and avoids replacing the full cylinder. I made this from PLA only because I had it in the printer at the time of need. Likely would be better printed in something more robust.

documents.author: archive_org
documents.description: This wall mountable holder should fit all batteries from the AP range (100, 200, 300, 300S). There is a single and a double battery design. Since these battery packs are expensive and do not like to be in the cold in the winter, I needed to store them in the house somewhere. To make this more convenient I made this battery holder. It is wall mountable with 4 mm countersunk woodscrews. This is a 'No8' woodscrew in Freedom units. The countersink in the design is such that they remain flush with the plastic and do not scratch the battery pack. While mounting them, keep in mind the battery sticks out a little bit from the bottom (see picture). When using the double version you should also leave enough finger space to push them out from the bottom. Since you cannot grab a battery comfortably when there are two next to each other. I added the fusion 360 file and a step file so that you can add some nifty labeling on the front side. Or remix with a coffee cup holder. If anybody from Stihl reads this, make this a thing I can buy and I will take it offline. You only offer solutions for large numbers of batteries, no love for the hobbyists :-(
